en: “But this time I'm not slacking off, it's a legit break.”
“Ha... it's too hot, so I took it off for a while.”
“Do you like me in the nun's robe?”
“What do you mean—Doesn't it look good on me?”
“It looks good, but it just doesn't suit you.”
“But more importantly, what snacks did you bring this time?”
“Yeah, I made them after you all left, they should taste pretty good.”
“Mmm... I want to take a photo first...”
“I also prepared some tea, please help yourself.”
“After eating sweets, I always feel like sleeping.”
“Then take a little rest, it'll do wonders for your energy.”
Ayano pats my thigh and lies down.
“So comfy—napping outside in this weather is the best.”
“Ah... Take a little nap, I'll wake you up.”
“Oh? Looks like you've gotten used to me. You don't look dazed or confused.”
“I've gotten used to expecting the unexpected from you, Ayano.”
“But there's a difference between doing a job and doing one's best.”
“Are you suggesting you're trying your best to meet our needs?”
“I thought you'd keep your distance from me.”
“After all, I was the one who made a move on you.”
“But you acted like nothing happened. You even got closer to me after that.”
“...To be honest, I feel like I've hit the jackpot.”
“Being able to do... that... with someone as beautiful as you. I'm elated...”
Ayano suddenly turns away, her face clearly flushing red.
“You don't like it when I compliment you?”
“I-I can't help it... even Shizuku knows I can't stand it...”
“But you'll let me do it... won't you?”
“I was just trying to tease you a bit... and now I'm the one getting teased!”
